'''1998 Juneau tournament''' was a sanctioned Swiss Star Wars CCG tournament in Juneau, Alaska, on 1 March 1998. [[Dave Estes]] was the tournament director. [[Chris Klint]] won.<ref name="list-35938">[http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/35938.html? swccg-discussion message #35938], [[Chris Klint]] (1 March 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000111054252/http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/35938.html? Internet Archive]</ref>

The field played constructed Swiss. Estes declined a Cloud City scenario format.<ref name="list-35938">[http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/35938.html? swccg-discussion message #35938], [[Chris Klint]] (1 March 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000111054252/http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/35938.html? Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Sanctioned Swiss
* '''Date:''' 1 March 1998
* '''Site:''' Juneau, Alaska
* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Cloud City]]

Klint's pairings included [[Adam Garrison]], [[Tim Shockley]], [[Tim Powers]], and a first-round opponent identified only as Lake. [[Lenard Smiley]] and [[Matt Monagle]] also played.<ref name="list-35938">[http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/35938.html? swccg-discussion message #35938], [[Chris Klint]] (1 March 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000111054252/http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/35938.html? Internet Archive]</ref>
